_note: Segment-driven model (as NYKAA / URBANCO). India multi-channel and International grow GMV; revenue and adjusted EBITDA are % of GMV. Globalbees, Others and inter-segment sales grow revenue directly. Segment EBITDA is the company's adjusted EBITDA (before ESOP cost, before rent under Ind AS 116); reported EBITDA = Σ segments + inter-segment EBITDA − ESOP. Valued on sum of the parts on Sep-28E (roll FY28E/FY29E 50:50). ₹ crore.

segments.name: India multi-channel
segments._why: India GMV grew 11% in FY26 (Q4 +12%) and 12% in Q1FY27, with revenue +17.7%. Management expects growth to stay "elevated" (RocketBees >50% of shipments, Qwik in 12 cities, ~100 new stores in FY27 after a pause). JM Financial assumes group GMV +13% / +12% / +12% (May-2026). We assume 13% a year: Q1's pace plus stores, below the high-teens of FY24.
segments._revWhy: Revenue was 58.8% of India GMV in FY26 and 61.1% in Q1FY27 (own manufacturing sales; GST cuts lowered MRP-based GMV). Held at 60.5%.
segments._marginWhy: Adjusted EBITDA was 8.8% of revenue in FY26 (9.5% in FY25) but 5.7% in Q1FY27 after a ~260bp gross-margin hit (diaper price war; rupee and crude in own manufacturing). Management expects input costs passed on by end-Q2 and diaper pricing to normalise over 4-6 quarters. We assume 7.6% / 8.6% / 9.2% of revenue (4.6% / 5.2% / 5.55% of GMV): FY27E below FY26, FY29E still below FY25.

segments.name: International (UAE, KSA)
segments._why: GMV +5% in FY26 (Q4 +2%) and +9% in Q1FY27 despite Gulf geopolitics and promotions by two horizontals. 9% / 11% / 12%.
segments._revWhy: Revenue was 50.9% of GMV in FY26 and 54.4% in Q1FY27 (more first-party sales); 53%.
segments._marginWhy: Adjusted EBITDA -9.6% of revenue in FY26, -7.2% in Q1FY27 (-25% in FY23). No breakeven date. We assume -6% / -3.5% / -1.5% of revenue (-3.2% / -1.85% / -0.8% of GMV): breakeven around FY30E.

segments.name: Globalbees (51.68% owned)
segments._why: Revenue +20% in FY26 (core brands +28%), flat in Q1FY27 (planned transition at one core brand, Flipkart settlement change); growth back from Q3. 10% for FY27E, then 16%.
segments._marginWhy: Adjusted EBITDA 3.0% in FY26, 3.9% in Q1FY27, 5.8% in Q4FY26; core brands ~5% after corporate cost. 4.5% / 5.5% / 6.5%.

segments.name: Others (preschools)
segments._why: Revenue +11% in FY26 and +47% in Q1FY27 as preschools double. 30% / 25% / 25%.
segments._marginWhy: Adjusted EBITDA 27% in FY26, 26% in Q1FY27; held at 26-28%.

segments.name: Inter-segment sales
segments._why: Consolidated revenue less the four segments: -₹94 cr in FY26 (-1.1%), -₹25 cr in Q1FY27. Grows with India multi-channel.
segments._marginWhy: Zero margin (PLAYBOOK §7); the small inter-segment EBITDA is in the unallocated line.

_unallocWhy: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA exceeded the four segments by ₹3.2 cr in FY26 and ₹0.8 cr in Q1FY27; kept at ₹3-4 cr (a negative cost).
_esopWhy: Share-based pay was ₹224 cr in FY26 and ₹30 cr in Q1FY27. The company's schedule for options already granted is ₹118 / 64 / 30 cr for FY27-FY29 (Q1FY27 presentation, slide 43); we add ~₹15-30 cr a year for new grants from FY28E.
_capexWhy: Cash capex ₹189 cr in FY26 (₹186 cr PPE + intangibles) plus ~₹145 cr of new leases (right-of-use additions), which the engine must carry so depreciation keeps pace. ~100 new stores in FY27 and more in FY28: ₹350 / 400 / 430 cr incl. leases.
_depWhy: D&A ₹407 cr in FY26 (8.6% of average gross block incl. right-of-use and brand intangibles; brand amortisation ₹88 cr, falling) and ₹94 cr in Q1FY27 (₹377 cr annualised). 8% gives ~₹400 cr in FY27E.
_treasuryWhy: The engine's treasury is net of all borrowings and lease liabilities (₹148 cr at Mar-26), so a 6% yield on it captures little of the interest actually earned on ₹1,741 cr of gross cash and deposits.
_otherIncomeWhy: Other income ₹184 cr in FY26: ₹99 cr interest on bank deposits (~5.6% on ~₹1,760 cr average), ₹15 cr other interest, ₹71 cr miscellaneous (incl. government grants). Q1FY27 ₹47 cr (Q1FY26 ₹48 cr). The fixed ₹175-180 cr plus the yield gives ₹184 cr in FY27E, in line with FY26 and the Q1 run-rate.
_interestLabel: Finance cost (lease interest + borrowings + earn-out unwinding)
_interestWhy: Finance cost ₹156 cr in FY26 (lease interest ₹103 cr) and ₹37 cr in Q1FY27; rising with new store leases.
_taxWhy: Profitable entities (India multi-channel parent, manufacturing) pay tax while Globalbees and International losses cannot be set off: tax was ₹37 cr in FY26 on a group loss. 60% of FY27E PBT gives ~₹42 cr; the rate falls toward 25% as losses shrink (JM assumes 22-24% from FY27E on a larger PBT).

otherTreasury.label: Bank deposits > 12 months
otherTreasury._why: Bank deposits with maturity beyond 12 months (₹333.8 cr, FY26 annual report note 10) sit in other non-current financial assets.

dcf._betaWhy: Loss-making consumer-internet retailer: 1.1 gives a 13.1% cost of equity, as for Urban Company and Meesho. Debt is small beyond leases, so cost of equity ≈ WACC.
dcf._fadeGrowthWhy: Revenue growth fades from ~14% (FY29E) to 9% by year 15.
dcf._fadeMarginWhy: 9% reported EBITDA margin (after ESOP, before rent) at maturity: India multi-channel at ~11% of revenue, International and Globalbees at mid-single digits.
dcf._fadeCapexWhy: Stores, warehouses and leases settle at ~2.5% of revenue.

parts.name: India multi-channel
parts.note: EV / one-year-forward sales derived from FirstCry's own trading over the last 12 months (1-Oct-2025 to 30-Sep-2026, after the IPO-premium months) × the internet sector's move over the same window (see the derivation table). One multiple for every segment, as the street's own SOTP works out to ~1.0-1.2x sales for each part.

parts.note: EV / one-year-forward sales derived from FirstCry's own trading over the last 12 months (1-Oct-2025 to 30-Sep-2026, after the IPO-premium months) × the internet sector's move over the same window (see the derivation table). One multiple for every segment, as the street's own SOTP works out to ~1.0-1.2x sales for each part.

One multiple for every segment, as the street's own SOTP works out to ~1.0-1.2x sales for each part.

One multiple for every segment, as the street's own SOTP works out to ~1.0-1.2x sales for each part.

parts.note: EV / one-year-forward sales derived from FirstCry's own trading over the last 12 months (1-Oct-2025 to 30-Sep-2026, after the IPO-premium months) × the internet sector's move over the same window (see the derivation table). One multiple for every segment, as the street's own SOTP works out to ~1.0-1.2x sales for each part.

parts.name: Globalbees minorities (48.32%)
parts.metricLabel: Sep-28E Globalbees revenue × −48.32% of the EV/sales multiple
parts.note: Globalbees is valued at 100% above; 48.32% of it belongs to other shareholders (FirstCry owns 51.68%, FY26 annual report), so their share is deducted (PLAYBOOK §7c).

parts.name: Globalbees earn-outs (FirstCry share)
parts.note: Consideration payable to selling shareholders of Globalbees brands, ₹387.5 cr at Mar-26 (FY26 annual report, notes 27-28): debt-like; FirstCry bears 51.68%.

parts.name: Net cash at end-FY27E (after leases)
parts.note: Model forecast: cash, bank balances, long deposits and investments less borrowings and lease liabilities at Mar-27. Leases are deducted because sales and adjusted EBITDA are before rent.

methods.name: Sum of the parts
methods.why: The street's method (JM Financial: segment SOTP on FY28E). Each segment at the EV/sales multiple derived from FirstCry's own trading and the sector move, Globalbees minorities and earn-outs deducted, plus net cash. Primary.

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: Whole-company cash flows over 15 years at a 13.1% cost of equity; includes 100% of Globalbees (minorities not deducted), so it flatters slightly.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA (street-implied)
methods.why: JM Financial's May-2026 SOTP implies ~13.5x its FY28E reported EBITDA (target EV ₹127 bn ÷ ₹9.3 bn); applied to our Sep-28E reported EBITDA (after ESOP, before rent).

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: India GMV grows ~16% a year as Qwik and new stores work and the diaper war ends; gross margin fully recovers (India adjusted EBITDA ~10% of revenue by FY29E); Globalbees grows ~20% at 7-8%; International breaks even by FY29E. Valued at FirstCry's own 12-month median EV/sales with no sector discount.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: Quick commerce keeps taking diapers and essentials: India GMV grows ~9%, margins stay near Q1FY27 levels (~7% of revenue); Globalbees stalls at ~10% growth and 3-5% margins; International losses persist. Valued at the 25th percentile of FirstCry's own range × the sector move.
